notes:
Composed of {弁|べん} (speech) and ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument/discussion). Has two main usage contexts: (1) in law, where ⟦{口頭|こうとう}→口頭：11892_koutou⟧{弁論|べんろん} (oral argument) refers to formal proceedings in court, and (2) in education, where {弁論|べんろん}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ (speech contest/debate tournament) is a common school event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{口頭|こうとう}→口頭：11892_koutou⟧{弁論|べんろん}: oral argument (legal)
- {弁論|べんろん}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: speech contest, debate tournament
- {弁論|べんろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold oral arguments
- {弁論|べんろん}⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧: art of rhetoric/debate
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{弁論|べんろん}: closing argument

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ディベート→ディベート：30371_dibeeto⟧: debate — loanword, refers specifically to competitive structured debate
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: discussion, debate — broader term for formal discussions
- ⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧: speech, address — one-directional public speaking, not back-and-forth
